column1: Hence, the overall price level depends on the expected price level and on the level of output. Algebraic rearrangement puts this aggregate pricing equation into a more familiar form: Y 5 Y – 1 a(P 2 EP), where a 5 s/[(1 2 s)a]. The sticky-price model says that the deviation of output from the natural level is positively associated with the deviation of the price level from the expected price level.
